app_fee.value: The application fee is $75 for international applicants ($65 for domestic).
app_fee.quote: You must pay the application fee $65 (domestic) or $75 (international).

also.quote: The graduate application fee is $65 for domestic students and $75 for international students.

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate School offers a limited number of waivers (Big Ten FreeApp, McNair, recruitment events). Its FreeApp route ends 12/31/2026 and some departments say they give none to international applicants, so check the department.
fee_waiver.quote: The Graduate School offers a limited number of these fee waivers for eligible applicants.

also.quote: Effective 12/31/2026, Michigan State University will no longer participate in the Big Ten Academic Alliance FreeApp Program.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School sets no GRE rule; each program decides (see program records).

toefl_min.value: University minimum TOEFL iBT 80 (no sub-score below 19 in reading, listening, speaking; 22 in writing) for tests before 21 Jan 2026; 4.5 on the new scale after that date. Some departments ask for more.
toefl_min.quote: No sub score below 19 for reading, listening, and speaking | No writing sub score below 22 | A minimum average score of 80**

also.quote: Score of 4.5 with a minimum score of 4 in reading and speaking, and a minimum score of 4.5 in listening and writing.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic minimum average 6.5 with no sub-score below 6.0.
ielts_min.quote: A minimum average score of 6.5 is required, with no subscore below 6.0.

english_waiver.value: No automatic waiver for an Indian degree: the department must request a non-automatic waiver with an official document from your university certifying that instruction was entirely in English, plus evidence of spoken English.
english_waiver.quote: The applicant has or is in the process of getting a degree from a university outside of the U.S. where the language of instruction is English. | An official document (in English) from the institution(s) certifying that the language of instruction was entirely English.

also.quote: Bachelor’s degree earned in the U.S. (or other English-speaking country).

notes: Graduate admissions are decentralised: departments review applications and set their own deadlines and GRE rules. The university-level fee is stated on department pages (statistics, mechanical engineering, biomolecular science). Fee waiver and ELP pages checked 2026-10-24.
